'''Veneka''' was a senior [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who was enrolled in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
A [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Veneka was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Veneka was stationed at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Battle of Kothlis]] and was joined by fellow Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as part of Green Team in a competition arranged by Master [[Taria Damsin]]. The competition, taking place in the new [[Sublevel nineteen training dojo]], ended in a tie. Veneka was one of the two members of Green Team to make it all the way through the dojo.<ref name="CWGS" />
